description: This file contains an abstract generic class 'GeneralizedValueTypeSurrogateCodec' implementing serialization logic for value types using surrogate serialization. It provides mechanisms to convert between a value type and its surrogate during serialization/deserialization processes, utilizing Orleans serialization interfaces.

classes.name: GeneralizedValueTypeSurrogateCodec
classes.description: An abstract codec class for serializing value types via surrogate types in Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value of type TField from the serialization stream, deserializing the surrogate and converting it to the field type.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a value of type TField into the serialization stream by converting it to its surrogate.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a surrogate value to the field value.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a field value into its surrogate form.
